episodes.162978: Scattered showers and thunderstorms impacted the desert to the coast on September 24. Locally heavy rainfall occurred across San Diego County with rainfall of 0.5 to 1 inch occurring, locally higher 1 to 2 inches near Palomar Mountain. A rare Severe Thunderstorm Warning was issued for downtown San Diego. Widespread hail and strong winds were reported.
